duplicateTitles.method: English-likely eligible titles; NFKD accent removal, casefold, Unicode word tokens, punctuation collapsed. Mask variant additionally removes the frozen baseline name-and-genre word list. Title families are not original-session families.

accountBalanced.method: Within-publisher unordered pair mean minus equal-other-publisher cross-pair mean, then equal-weight mean across focal publishers with at least two documents. Singleton publishers contribute only to between-publisher reference.

crossLayerContrast.meaning: Difference of within-minus-between cosine separations in two different text representations on identical upload IDs; cosine scales are representation-specific, so this is a descriptive sensitivity, not a calibrated semantic effect.

limitations: Frozen convenience-sample upload index, not a comprehensive channel crawl or active-practitioner census.
The caption pilot is purposive; raw text and audio are unavailable for new speaker or accuracy validation.
Publisher, practitioner, claimed entity and original recording are distinct units.
Dictionary keyword indicators are overlapping unvalidated lexical detections; upload titles do not establish spoken content.
Upload duration bands are length strata, not manually verified performance-format labels.
Publisher-label permutation is descriptive; dependent cosine pairs do not provide independent inferential observations.
No question-answer agreement, truth or extraterrestrial provenance is inferred.

hypothesisOutcomes.result: 2 of 9 pooled directions match paired-account median directions; zeros count only when both zero

figures.title: Retained evidence coverage
figures.caption: Counts share the 925-upload index denominator. English caption pilot coverage is a selected analysis subset, not an estimated availability rate. Known duration means positive duration; date means exact indexed date.

figures.title: Concentration of indexed uploads
figures.caption: 886 attributed uploads across 180 nonempty publishing-account groups; 39 unresolved uploads are excluded from this account concentration denominator and retained elsewhere. Empty account routes are excluded. This is index composition, not YouTube-wide concentration.

figures.title: Duration of the selected caption pilot
figures.alt: Duration of the selected caption pilot
figures.caption: Positive-duration uploads only: caption pilot n=30, other uploads within pilot publishing accounts n=430, all other indexed uploads n=851. The two comparator sets overlap. Bars are empirical interquartile ranges, not confidence intervals. No selection mechanism or population inference is estimated.

figures.title: Title keyword indicators by duration band
figures.alt: Title keyword indicators by duration band
figures.caption: 702 English-likely eligible titles with positive measured duration. Cells are title-level shares matching at least one transparent topic regex; categories overlap and are unvalidated. Length bands are not manually verified upload-format labels. Titles describe publishing language, not necessarily speech or answers.

figures.title: Publisher association in matched text representations
figures.alt: Publisher association in matched text representations
figures.caption: Identical 25 uploads from 14 publishing accounts support both panels; 11 accounts have within-account pairs and three are singletons. Boxplots show empirical medians/IQRs and whiskers at 1.5 IQR, not confidence intervals. Pair scores share uploads and are dependent. Vectors are retained MiniLM derivatives; no new model execution or speech validation.

figures.title: Publisher-label negative control
figures.caption: 2,000 fixed-seed publisher-label permutations on the same 25 vectors preserve publisher group sizes and destroy their observed associations. The reference is a descriptive diagnostic, not a population p-value, semantic validity test, or experimental effect. Cosine scales differ between title and caption representations.
